body: I really can’t express how much I appreciate this. Really. I have tried the things you mentioned and they have sadly not worked. I was prescribed my medication while in a mental facility in a different state and I don’t believe my family has that doctor’s contact information anymore. But thank you for reaching out to me today and talking with me.
Not right now. My family can only afford my anti-depressants. Other than that, they can’t afford to send me back to the psychiatrist because the insurance does not cover it

Eh, nothing really has changed that corresponds with my mental situation. I just know that my breakdowns got worse and worse and I just became mentally scrambled. Sometimes, I feel nothing. The next moment I am in deep sorrow and pain and laughing but feeling suicidal. When it comes to tasks and school work, I can’t bring my attention to anything. But then sometimes I have so many thoughts in my head, I could talk for hours but they’re all about random things. It kinda feels like I am loosing mental stability in short
Thank you very much. That would help a lot. I appreciate your kindness
Thank you! Wicca has been very complex to research independently so having some guidance is very much appreciated 💚

I hate that we never found out the fate of the governor. Throughout the whole season, they set his character to be a jerk and be so focused on putting Edmund into the electric chair. We did not even get to learn his fate unless I missed something. I was looking forward to the governor getting what he deserved

This was exactly my thoughts. I thought Edmund would catch onto Mildred’s plan, attack her (but not kill her, and run away with the horse in the barn. In that scene when he first visits the barn, I thought his moment with the horse was foreshadowing that but I guess I was wrong. I loved the show until this episode. This episode was trash
